Hi Sophie — thanks for the detail and the attachment.

We can do both: issue two tax-compliant invoices (US/EU split) and apply a corrective service credit for the Oct 18-19 burst where reserved capacity was not honored. To proceed we need:

- Confirmation of entity legal names and VAT ID for the EU entity (please send the exact registered name and VAT number).
- Confirmation that you want the credit applied as a negative line on the new EU invoice or as a separate credit memo. (Our default is a separate credit memo, but we can also merge it into the re-issued invoice if you prefer netted accounting.)
- Any line-level mapping file linking resource identifiers to the entity to split charges (sample CSV is fine).

I’ve looped in Laura from Billing to handle the invoice generation and Marcus from Finance Ops for the credit calculation and tax treatment. We’ll prepare a proposed breakdown and a draft credit memo within 5 business days once we have the VAT ID and mapping.

Thanks —
